races.name: Supporting Home Run Hounds North West Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Georgemani
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 81 days with David Dennis showing decent recent form but pulled up on hurdles debut
runners_data.comment: Always behind and pulled up on January's hurdle debut; possibly one for longer term.
runners_data.spotlight: Hinted at ability in his sole start in a point but always behind and pulled up on hurdle/rules debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in January; possibly one for further down the line.

runners_data.name: Shantou Premier
runners_data.note: Unknown style runner for Christian Williams off a 351-day absence making this a complete mystery

runners_data.name: Untapped Potential
runners_data.note: Unknown style but strong Irish point form including wide-margin victory, though Henry Oliver's yard struggling
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who looks the type to make an impact over hurdles; one to consider.
runners_data.spotlight: 47,000euros purchase after winning his third start in Irish points by a wide margin (runner-up and third well held since); half-brother to 2m1f/2m5f hurdle winner Major Barry; looks the type to make an impact over hurdles and one to consider on rules debut.

runners_data.name: Yellow Warning
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won recent Irish point but unseated at first on stable debut last month
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who was 80-1 when unseating on hurdle debut last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £10,000 after narrowly winning an Irish point (yielding to soft) in October; 80-1 when unseating at the first in a C&D maiden on last month's stable/hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Neon Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid RPR 125 for Alan King, placed twice from three hurdle starts on similar going

runners_data.name: Granite Sands
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 143 days, showed promise in Doncaster bumper but disappointed since
runners_data.comment: Needs to learn to settle, but he could progress if the addition of a hood helps.
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth in a Doncaster (2m, good) bumper on debut in March last year; however, he failed to build on that at Southwell (2m, soft) on his return in November, failing to settle and ultimately well held; steps up in trip for this switch to hurdles after another break, with hood added.

runners_data.name: Elusive Pb
runners_data.note: Natural leader with consistent form, beaten 17 lengths on hurdles debut but handles conditions perfectly
runners_data.comment: Placed in bumpers and confirmed that promise on recent hurdle debut; longer trip may suit.
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two bumpers on heavy ground and confirmed that promise, albeit beaten 17l, when fifth of 14 on hurdles debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to prove himself on quicker ground, but his pedigree suggests the step up in trip should suit.

runners_data.name: Ballymoreen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying 7lbs penalty, ex-Irish with winning bumper form and improving over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Yet to match her Wexford bumper win in two runs over hurdles, but likely to be in the mix.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; bought for £70,000 after landing a Wexford bumper in October; improved upon her hurdles/stable debut when a respectable third in a 2m mares' contest here in February, shaping as though this step back up in trip would suit; likely to be involved.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Fortune
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse tongue-tied both starts, tailed off on debut and fell at first last time
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in his bumper and got no further that the first on last month's hurdle debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Tongue tied both starts; related to winners but tailed off in a Chepstow bumper on debut and got no further than the first switched to hurdles last month.

runners_data.name: Ample Warning
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed promise at Ludlow but disappointed when remote seventh most recently
runners_data.comment: Needs to leave behind a disappointing run last time, but she remains open to progress.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise switched to hurdles at Ludlow (2m) in December following a lengthy absence, making the frame, but failed to build on that when a remote seventh of 11 at Warwick (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to leave that effort behind, but remains open to progress; stable runs two.

runners_data.name: Lady Blackmore
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with dual Irish point placings but yet to make serious impact over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Mildly progressive so far over hurdles, but this longer trip could unlock improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in both Irish points last year and, while yet to make a serious impact in three runs over hurdles (all at 2m), she's been steadily progressing; more is needed, but this longer trip could prompt further improvement; one of two for the stable.

races.paceDynamic: Elusive Pb will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed leaders in the field. Ballymoreen can press from prominent early but lacks the natural speed to challenge for the lead. The confirmed front-runner will face minimal early pressure over this 2m3½f trip, allowing him to settle into a rhythm and control fractions throughout. This sustainable gallop strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late, as the pace will be moderate early and build gradually.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Elusive Pb Controls Everything
scenarios.trigger: If Elusive Pb jumps cleanly and faces no early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable fractions and proves hard to peg back, while hold-up horses find the pace too honest late. His recent Exeter run shows he stays this trip and handles good ground perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Materializes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows hold-up horses to close with finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Hold-up runners benefit from the patient ride and Elusive Pb's lack of natural speed tells in the final furlong. The class horses with RPRs around 107 come to the fore late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Untapped Potential Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the Irish point winner translates his dominant form to hurdles racing
scenarios.body: His wide-margin Irish point victory suggests he has more ability than his maiden hurdle debut showed. Henry Oliver's yard form is poor but this horse has legitimate class credentials.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers shows dramatic improvement from previous efforts
scenarios.body: The maiden hurdle nature means any horse can improve significantly, particularly those with point-to-point form. Yellow Warning's recent Irish point win gives him an outside chance.

watchPoints.text: Sea Of Fortune has fallen at the first hurdle and been tailed off in his only two starts
Yellow Warning unseated at the first fence on his stable debut and represents a jumping risk early
Shantou Premier returns after 351 days off for Christian Williams and could need the run badly
Elusive Pb must jump cleanly as the likely leader since any early mistake would compromise his front-running tactics
Untapped Potential represents the strongest Irish point form but Henry Oliver's yard is winless from seven recent runners

races.name: Wye Valley Group Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jackeline
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, only 2 days since last run could be a concern

runners_data.name: Independent Lady
runners_data.note: Front-runner with winning C&D form on good ground, perfectly positioned to exploit this weak pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Won on handicap debut over C&D last month; up 5lb; another bold bid can be expected.
runners_data.spotlight: Left behind her qualifying runs when making a winning handicap debut over C&D (good) last month, asserting in good style from a fair yardstick; 5lb rise looks manageable and another bold bid can be expected.

runners_data.name: Innisfree Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style mare who showed promise on handicap debut, needs others to go hard enough early
runners_data.comment: Up 2lb but a leading player after a promising start to handicaps over hurdles last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Well held on first two starts over hurdles late last year but, after a respectable fourth back on the Flat (1m6f) in January, made a promising handicap debut over hurdles when keeping on for second at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month; 2lb rise looks fair and she is high on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Ballerina Boxer
runners_data.note: Held-up runner from struggling trainer, pulled up on soft ground last time suggests going preference
runners_data.comment: Has offered little encouragement in two starts for new stable and easy to look elsewhere.
runners_data.spotlight: 3m Punchestown handicap hurdle winner off a similar mark in June but below that level since; little encouragement in two starts for new yard, pulling up on soft ground then well beaten (46l) at Stratford; has plenty to prove on current evidence.

runners_data.name: Miss Kassiopi
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer, 42 days off could bring improvement for in-form jockey Bannister

runners_data.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could provide early company to Independent Lady, switching to handicaps may help
runners_data.comment: Could have more to offer now switching to handicaps, with market support worth noting.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point; has only hinted at ability in three runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f) but could have more to offer now switching to handicaps and market support would be significant.

runners_data.name: Adaay Dancing
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with tongue-tie fitted, needs pace collapse to be competitive from this mark

runners_data.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with tongue-tie and cheekpieces, backwards step last time is concerning
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on an encouraging stable debut last time; cheekpieces now reached for.
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to progress for previous stable last season and, having shaped with promise over C&D for new stable in January, took a backwards step at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month when finishing last of eight; needs the fitting of cheekpieces to get quickly back on track.

races.paceDynamic: Independent Lady will take the field along from the front with only Shanagolden Girl potentially providing company in the early stages. With most runners preferring to come from behind (Jackeline, Innisfree Pearl, Ballerina Boxer, Miss Kassiopi, Adaay Dancing, Jessie Jump Jet), Independent Lady can dictate a moderate gallop without serious pressure. The sustainable tempo will allow her to control the race from flag to finish, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces. This race shape strongly favours the front-running/prominent runners who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably develop behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Lady gets an easy lead and maintains her recent winning form
scenarios.body: She can control the pace throughout and kick clear when it matters, making it very difficult for the hold-up brigade to reel her in. Her course and distance win last month in similar conditions makes her the logical beneficiary of this pace setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and allows closers to wind up effectively
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the final furlong. Jackeline and Innisfree Pearl would be the main beneficiaries of a truly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If Shanagolden Girl presses Independent Lady early creating a more honest gallop
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical affair where horses with tactical speed can position well and strike late. This brings more runners into contention but still favours those who can travel strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Lady fails to handle the 5lb rise or the front-running tactics backfire
scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy with no clear leader, creating a scrambling finish that could suit an outsider coming through late. This would open up the race significantly.

watchPoints.text: Independent Lady could get far too easy a lead with only Shanagolden Girl for early company
Watch for Jackeline being given too much to do from the back if the pace becomes truly pedestrian
Miss Kassiopi has been off 42 days which could bring needed improvement for this hold-up performer
Ballerina Boxer's recent form is poor and pulling up on soft suggests ground conditions matter
Shanagolden Girl switching to handicaps could unlock improvement after modest novice form

races.name: Visit Herefordshire Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Graecia
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong claims if avoiding her recent over-racing tendencies, needs to settle better than in recent SOF ground efforts
runners_data.comment: Below best of late but she's hard to ignore given her second to White Noise in December.
runners_data.spotlight: Has been disappointing of late and can compromise her chances by over-racing, but would have strong claims if back to the form of her Newbury effort (2m, good to soft) in December, namely second to Cheltenham Festival winner White Noise; worth a second look with promising claimer Daire McConville back in the saddle.

runners_data.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners_data.note: Prominent runner improving with each start over hurdles, shaped well when third here last month on similar ground conditions
runners_data.comment: Opening mark is no gift but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting.
runners_data.spotlight: Has taken time to come to hand over hurdles but his recent third over 2m4f here last month represented by far his best effort, appreciating the better ground; opening mark is no gift, but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Lord Chamberlain
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best hurdle effort came at Ludlow on good to soft, needs to bounce back from disappointing Huntingdon run
runners_data.comment: Modest effort on latest start but he brings potential switched to handicaps.
runners_data.spotlight: Five-race Flat maiden; clear pick of his three hurdle runs when third of seven at Ludlow (2m, good to soft); needs to leave behind a lesser effort at Huntingdon (2m, good) last time when ridden more prominently, but he brings potential now stepping into handicaps.

runners_data.name: Getaway With You
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won three in succession before two lesser efforts, longer 36-day break could have refreshed him
runners_data.comment: Latest run may have come too soon latest, but could resume progress after a short break.
runners_data.spotlight: Won three in a row in November/December (2m3f-2m4f) and scored at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) in February; well-held fourth eight days later at Ffos Las, possibly finding the quick turnaround too much; may resume progress, though the drop in trip is a slight concern.

runners_data.name: Bongo Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with consistent placed record, recent second at this course suggests he handles the track well

runners_data.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners_data.note: Front-runner carrying just 156lbs, heavy ground likely compromised his last effort so better surface should suit
runners_data.comment: Better can be expected returned to a more suitable surface, on second start in a handicap.
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise in juvenile hurdles in December, and although his run last month on handicap debut was a shade disappointing, the heavy ground likely counted against him; hood worn the last twice is retained, and a better showing can be expected from this 4yo returned to a more suitable surface.

runners_data.name: Granny B
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after 170-day absence, long layoff and inconsistent form make her hard to recommend despite light weight
runners_data.comment: 15-race maiden who returns on a competitive mark, but with something to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to win in 15 starts over hurdles, having shown some promising placed efforts last summer before her form dipped in the autumn, and she was last seen finishing lame (well held) at Stratford in October; returns on a competitive mark, but with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Desert Halo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won last time out on soft ground, shorter 28-day gap keeps him race-fit

runners_data.name: For Old Times Sake
runners_data.note: Front-runner with tendency to fade in finish, needs to sustain gallop better than in recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Difficult to recommend on recent form, but given his pointing promise, he may do better.
runners_data.spotlight: Has yet to match his Irish point promise in five hurdle races, but did take a step forward on handicap debut in a hood at Huntingdon (2m, heavy) in February before disappointing when a well-backed favourite upped to 2m5f back there the following month (good, hood removed); may do better in time, but difficult to recommend on recent form.

runners_data.name: Now Then Wendy
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare whose best form was on softer surfaces, aging 9-year-old facing stronger opposition than usual

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was third here 12 days ago, quick turnaround and modest overall ability limit appeal
runners_data.comment: Produced one of his best efforts when third over C&D last month, but needs more again.
runners_data.spotlight: 1m5f AW Flat winner who has shown only a modest level of ability in a dozen runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f); produced one of his better efforts when third over C&D last month, though beaten 16l; probably place claims at best from out of the weights.

races.paceDynamic: Bouquet De Paris and For Old Times Sake will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over this 2-mile trip. Kingdom Of Stars may sit prominent just behind the leaders, while the majority of the field including Graecia, Lord Chamberlain, Bongo Man, Desert Halo and the bottom weights will settle further back. For Old Times Sake has a tendency to fade in the finish which could leave Bouquet De Paris exposed if the pace becomes searching. This honest gallop over 2 miles on good ground will favour horses with prominent/midfield positions who can position handy and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners settle into a moderate early gallop and reserve energy for the finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle, suiting hold-up horses with tactical speed. Graecia and Bongo Man can use their class advantage in a finish that becomes all about who has most left in the tank.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Exposes Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris and For Old Times Sake go too fast early trying to establish dominance
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the straight as both leaders fade, allowing prominent racers to inherit the lead. Kingdom Of Stars and Getaway With You benefit from sitting just off the unsustainable tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris gets an uncontested lead with For Old Times Sake failing to go the pace
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old dictates throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges on ground that suits. His light weight of 156lbs becomes a decisive advantage when the field tries to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Benefits Freshest
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is messy with several horses vying for position through the first mile
scenarios.body: The race fragments with no clear tempo, suiting horses who can adapt and have recent race fitness. Desert Halo and those with shorter layoffs can capitalize on the tactical nature.

watchPoints.text: For Old Times Sake could compromise the race if he sets unsustainable fractions then fades, creating a messy pace scenario
Graecia's tendency to over-race early could ruin her chances despite having the highest class rating in the field
Kingdom Of Stars has been improving with each run and represents the Lee stable which had zero winners from two recent runners
Bouquet De Paris carrying the lightest weight could get an easy lead if For Old Times Sake doesn't travel early
Several hold-up horses including Bongo Man and Desert Halo have recent course experience which could prove decisive

races.name: Green Dragon Hotel Hereford Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: The Long Walk
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 40-day break with solid Market Rasen third form, benefits from 2lb drop in handicap mark
runners_data.comment: One bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; first foray beyond an extended 2m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Third at Market Rasen (extended 2m2f, good to soft) on Boxing Day has been the only bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; now has a 2lb lower mark and goes beyond an extended 2m4f for the first time.

runners_data.name: Despereaux
runners_data.note: Front-running style suits with Jane Williams in good form, recent Chepstow win shows he handles similar conditions well

runners_data.name: Double Click
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist gains significant 5lb claim from Isabelle Ryder, recent Exeter rally suggests stamina reserves intact
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent but a better latest effort;  more to prove if ground is not softer than good
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent over the last 12 months or so, but second at Exeter in November showed that he stays 2m7f and his best effort since was on latest outing (a rallying third over 2m4f three weeks ago); much more to prove if the ground is not softer than good, but he has to be considered.

runners_data.name: Lelantos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Henderson stable, Huntingdon victory over extended trip suggests ideal conditions here
runners_data.comment: Won at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f) in November; backward steps in his two starts since
runners_data.spotlight: 5-27 over hurdles, the latest win gained at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f, good to soft; 2lb higher today) in November; has a shout on that showing but there have been backward steps in his two starts since.

runners_data.name: Woodythewoodpecker
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse seeking first win but two recent seconds over similar trips at Hereford and Fontwell show clear progression
runners_data.comment: 0-10; handicaps on last four starts, on last two occasions runner-up over 3m2f on soft
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; sent handicapping for last four starts, on last two occasions finishing runner-up on soft going over 3m2f at this track and Fontwell; different ground is forecast today but he's in serious calculations.

runners_data.name: Malago Rose
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with consistent placing record this season, 7lb claimer Tucker reduces effective burden significantly
runners_data.comment: Creditable minor honours all four starts this term, albeit favourite first three occasions
runners_data.spotlight: 19 races for two wins, the latest in January 2025; creditable minor honours on all four starts this season, albeit as favourite on first three occasions; one of those was under Harriet Tucker; stays 3m2f and will probably be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: The Jam Man
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner whose last rules win came in 2020, 13-year-old age a clear concern despite recent Chepstow fourth
runners_data.comment: Veteran; has had a 37lb fall in the weights this term but does not persuade
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran whose last win under rules was in 2020 (won a point early in 2024); fourth of 16 at Chepstow in January may look the only positive result in his nine races this season but he was beaten 35l, so that does not persuade; not even with his 37lb fall in the weights this term.

races.paceDynamic: The Long Walk and Despereaux are the only confirmed front runners, with The Long Walk likely to take them along at a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. With most of the field adopting prominent positions (Lelantos, Malago Rose, The Jam Man), there's unlikely to be fierce early pressure on the leaders. The lack of true hold-up specialists means the pace could become steady through the middle sections, setting up a tactical affair where positioning and stamina become crucial. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with proven staying power who can track the pace and strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Stayers
scenarios.trigger: If The Long Walk sets an uncontested lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows stamina horses like Lelantos and Woodythewoodpecker to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kicks. Henderson's charge and the improving maiden benefit most from this searching test of stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Long Walk and Despereaux establish an unassailable advantage through controlled fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent pair use their tactical speed to build a decisive lead, with Jane Williams' charge proving strongest in the closing stages. Their early positioning proves decisive as the closers struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble Develops
scenarios.trigger: If several horses challenge The Long Walk simultaneously turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where class and recent form prove decisive over pure stamina. Double Click's hold-up style gives him the tactical edge as others clash for position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If The Long Walk goes too slowly and the field bunches dangerously
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine early pace creates a stop-start affair where Double Click's patient tactics and Ryder's 5lb claim prove telling. The Jamie Snowden runner times his challenge perfectly as others struggle with the messy tempo.

watchPoints.text: The Long Walk could steal this if allowed uncontested lead from flag-fall given his front-running style and 40-day freshness
Double Click's inconsistency makes him unreliable despite Isabelle Ryder's valuable 5lb claim and suitable hold-up style
Woodythewoodpecker has never won in ten attempts but two recent Hereford seconds suggest this track suits his style perfectly
The Jam Man at 13 years old represents significant age concern despite showing some life in recent Chepstow fourth
Lelantos carries Henderson's powerful 4/9 14-day strike rate but 50-day layoff could blunt his finishing kick slightly

races.name: We Are Farming Minds Charity Partner Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: That's Nice
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with top-class handler Nicky Henderson, but shaky fence jumping could prove costly in a small field where mistakes are magnified
runners_data.comment: Won Irish point; 2-3 in novice hurdles; shaky switch to fences; had wind op since latest
runners_data.spotlight: Won sole Irish point and two of three novice hurdles (both 2m3f, good to soft); shaky transition to fences but she jumped soundly in a five-runner Newbury race in February before stopping to nothing under pressure; wind surgery since could have helped; retains potential.

runners_data.name: Malaita
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who should get an uncontested lead, but 10-year-old legs and poor trainer form this season raise stamina doubts
runners_data.comment: Had a difficult winter but return to 2m4f on good ground can suit; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Two chase wins at about 2m4f in early 2024 (soft and good); has not found life easy this winter but 3m found her out on her latest start (first-time tongue-tie; cheekpieces now added) and the return to shorter on good ground should suit; bold bid likely.

runners_data.name: Party Vibes
runners_data.note: Prominent type who has won twice this year but both on softer ground, plus heavy defeats on similar good going suggest surface concerns
runners_data.comment: Both chase wins on good to soft; has struggled on heavy and soft of late; possible reviver
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle winner on soft but two chase wins in 2025 were on good to soft, latterly at Cheltenham (about 2m4f) in December, and failures since have come on heavy and soft; needs to jump better than she did at Ludlow in February (over 17l behind Malaita) but she could revive back on good ground.

runners_data.name: Belle Montrose
runners_data.note: Hold-up merchant carrying bottom weight with recent wins and tongue-tie fitted, but lack of early pace in small field may not suit waiting tactics

races.paceDynamic: Malaita will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the off, setting a controlled but steady gallop with no other confirmed leaders to pressure her. That's Nice and Party Vibes will track in behind as prominent runners, while Belle Montrose sits last in the small field. With Malaita allowed to dictate terms unopposed, she can string the field out and make it a test of stamina in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without having to mount a sustained challenge from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Malaita Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Malaita jumps cleanly and maintains her lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when it matters, making life difficult for those tracking behind. Her two wins at this trip earlier in 2024 show she has the tactical speed to win from the front when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Take Over
scenarios.trigger: If That's Nice or Party Vibes move up to challenge Malaita turning for home
scenarios.body: The Henderson mare has superior class ratings and Party Vibes has recent Cheltenham form, giving either the ability to outstay Malaita in a driving finish. Both can benefit from tracking the pace without doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early and Belle Montrose gets a perfect stalking trip
scenarios.body: She can pick up the pieces as a fresher finisher with her recent winning form, exploiting any collapse from those who went too hard. Her hold-up style could prove effective if the others tie up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Malaita goes too fast early and the race becomes a war of attrition
scenarios.body: The small field spreads out and it becomes about who has anything left in the tank, potentially suiting whichever horse has been given the most economical ride. Class could tell in a slow-motion finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch Malaita's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes could hand initiative to the Henderson mare tracking behind
Monitor Party Vibes for any signs of laboring on this good ground compared to her softer surface victories
Belle Montrose needs others to go fast enough early to set up her late run in this small field
That's Nice showed jumping frailties at Newbury and cannot afford similar errors with so few rivals to hide behind

races.name: Spa Motors Hereford Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Edgewell
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid recent form including a course win, though faces tactical disadvantage against uncontested leader

runners_data.name: Jukebox d'Eddy
runners_data.note: Front runner with perfect tactical setup, excellent course record, though 26-day break adds minor question mark

runners_data.name: Walkinthewoods
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with stamina concerns beyond 2m4f and needs everything to fall right from poor tactical position
runners_data.comment: Failed to complete in 2 of 3 runs since back chasing and best form at about 2m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Best at about 2m4f and he's looked to have stamina limitations in the majority of his runs beyond that trip; below his latest winning mark, last May, but he's failed to complete in two of his last three runs since back chasing and some reservations remain.

runners_data.name: Braganza Bay
runners_data.note: Course winner returning to fences but hasn't found form since comeback, needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on latest two chase starts in 2024; below best  since absence; well treated now
runners_data.spotlight: Has won two of five handicaps here, hurdles and fences (C&D; good), but he hasn't yet found his form since back from an absence and now tackles fences for the first time since pulling up twice at the end of 2024; below latest winning mark but questions remain.

runners_data.name: Meranti
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner with recent poor form including two pull-ups, hard to see competitive claims
runners_data.comment: Has shown staying ability over fences but in moderate form since back from absence
runners_data.spotlight: Showed staying promise over fences earlier in career but he's been in moderate form since back from an absence, pulling up on last two starts.

races.paceDynamic: Jukebox d'Eddy is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset in this small field of five. With four hold-up horses (Edgewell, Walkinthewoods, Braganza Bay, Meranti) content to sit behind, there's no pressure on the leader to go fast early. This creates a perfect tactical scenario where Jukebox d'Eddy can bowl along at a comfortable rhythm before quickening when ready. The race shape strongly favours the front runner who gets an uncontested lead and can control the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jukebox Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Jukebox d'Eddy gets the expected soft lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate fractions and has first run on the field, while the hold-up brigade face a bunched finish where traffic and timing become crucial. His recent wins from the front and strong course record make him perfectly suited to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses times their challenge perfectly despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely run and creates gaps for closers, with Edgewell's recent good form and proven ability at the trip making him the most likely beneficiary. Walkinthewoods could also benefit if the race becomes a true staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stops
scenarios.trigger: If Jukebox d'Eddy's 26-day break or the step up in trip catches up with him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The leader's advantage evaporates late, creating opportunities for those with proven stamina reserves over the extended distance. Edgewell's recent course win and solid recent form makes him best placed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders all underperform and an outsider sneaks through
scenarios.body: Form horses disappoint and create an opening for Meranti despite his recent poor efforts, or Braganza Bay finally shows his return to form. This requires multiple failures from the principals.

watchPoints.text: Jukebox d'Eddy getting any early pressure from the other runners would completely change the race dynamic
Braganza Bay's jumping on return to fences after recent hurdles runs could be rusty early on
Walkinthewoods showing any early enthusiasm that contradicts his usual hold-up style
Edgewell's ability to get competitive position from the back given limited pace scenario
Meranti's behavior early given recent pulling-up tendency and long absence

races.name: Richard Layton Charity Evening 16th April Open NH Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Plan De Stan
runners_data.comment: Clear second of 12 over C&D on debut in December; has another big role to play
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well for clear second of 12 in soft-ground junior bumper over C&D in December and has another big role to play if suited by the faster ground today; had wind op in February.

runners_data.name: Cantcallherthat
runners_data.comment: Out of a close relative of a bumper winner; market support will make her of interest
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam pulled up in points, closely related to winners Carrigmore Mollie (bumper) and Kingston King (chase); stable does well in bumpers; market support will bring her into the equation.

runners_data.name: Clovers Frontier
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to stable's winning jumpers Mix Of Clover and Glance From Clover; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to connections' winners Mix Of Clover (2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Glance From Clover (3m1f chase/3m2f hurdle); dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/useful 2m chase winner Wilde Pastures; well worth a glance in the betting.

runners_data.name: Cobbler's Lad
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to connections' hurdle winner Keep On Cobbling; yard not prolific in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to connections' 2m/2m5f hurdle winner Keep On Cobbling; dam 2m6f-3m hurdle/chase winner, sister to smart jumper Rebel Du Maquis; trainer has relatively modest strike-rate in bumpers.

runners_data.name: Crystal Anthem
runners_data.comment: Out of half-sister to smart jumper O O Seven; stable 0-20 in bumpers (last five seasons)
runners_data.spotlight: 38,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Just Golden; dam unraced half-sister to bumper and smart jumps winner O O Seven; stable 0-20 in bumpers in last five seasons; considered only if lively in the betting.

runners_data.name: Meli Melo d'Angos
runners_data.comment: First foal from a French chase winner; stable punches above its weight in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam French 2m4f/2m5f chase winner; stable punches above its weight in bumpers; no surprise if he features.

runners_data.name: Uncle Bob
runners_data.comment: 1,000gns 2yo; not an obvious type for bumpers based on sprinting pedigree
runners_data.spotlight: 1,000gns 2yo; first foal; dam unraced sister to Flat winners Doctor Khan Junior (useful 6f/7f) and Margot Robbie (7f), half-sister to useful 6f winner Pocklington; not an obvious type for bumpers based on pedigree.

runners_data.name: Falconella
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to connections' useful bumper/hurdle winner Moon Chime; quite interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to connections' useful bumper/hurdle winner Moon Chime and another hurdle winner; dam 2m hurdle winner, sister to AQPS Flat and smart jumps winner Sweet My Lord; wears a tongue-tie on debut; looks quite interesting.

runners_data.name: Final Surprise
runners_data.comment: Placed on Irish point debut and has also shown clear promise in both bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on Irish point debut last spring (good ground) and also showed clear promise in first two bumpers (one over C&D); considered each-way.

runners_data.name: Crystal Jet
runners_data.comment: Out of a Listed Flat winner; placed in two fillies' bumpers in the autumn; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a Listed Flat winner; placed twice in the autumn, against others fillies in junior bumpers at Stratford (good to soft) and Huntingdon (good); sports first-time cheekpieces here; ought to be on the premises again.
